component.name: Couchtunes
component.summary: An Apple Music-style player for your Navidrome server

description.p: This is a community package of Couchtunes. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

Couchtunes plays the music on your own Navidrome (Subsonic / OpenSubsonic) server in a clean, big-screen layout. It is built to be driven with arrow keys, a TV remote or a game controller, and it works with a mouse and keyboard too.
Features include synced lyrics, an Up next queue, search with an on-screen keyboard, album, artist and playlist pages, light and dark themes, and keyboard and controller shortcuts.
Couchtunes is an independent project. It is not affiliated with Apple or Navidrome.
This package follows stable upstream releases only. Beta releases are not included.

Game controllers need access to input devices, so this package is granted all devices. Couchtunes uses native Wayland when it is available; if it misbehaves on your desktop, start it on X11 instead: flatpak run --env=COUCHTUNES_X11=1 io.github.captechomar.Couchtunes
